classic.note: Classic plus shared production code retains the established release floor.

organic.note: Extended-bank release floor: high aggregate decision coverage plus a per-file floor to prevent helpers from masking weak algorithm coverage.

measurement_rules.note: Bank scopes measure only bank-owned production sources. Compiler-generated exception and unreachable branches are excluded so branch coverage tracks executable project decisions rather than toolchain artefacts.

note: Do not lower release coverage floors to accommodate regressions. Add tests or document and exclude genuinely unreachable/generated branches instead.
